Accordingly, the Petitioner’s contention that the project’s commissioning was delayed due to the non-availability of space from the PTCUL is rejected. Further, the Petitioner, with the submitted supporting documents, failed to substantiate when HVPNL made available the inputs for integration to the Petitioner and how the same affected the overall commissioning of the Communication System. Accordingly, the Petitioner’s contention regarding the time overrun on account of delay in providing inputs for database development by State constituents is hereby rejected. The time overrun claimed by the Petitioner, 282 days from 7.3.2022 to 13.12.2022, is accordingly not condoned.
